The balance sheet shows only break-even liquidity (current ratio 1.00) and a very large retained earnings deficit, while profitability is modest relative to the asset base (EBIT of 283M on 48,860M of assets). Although book equity is still substantial versus liabilities, the weak cumulative earnings profile and limited operating cushion fit a speculative-grade profile rather than investment grade.

DECISION: BB-
